r.t: Niu Youdao - Plan in the Heavenly Realm
Setting:
In the current world, there are 7 states: Yan, Chu, Jin, Song, Han, Qi, and Wei. Each state has many small sects, along with 3 major sects supporting each state to maintain the balance of power.
Besides the 7 states, there are people outside the borders known as the Overseas.
Piao Miao Pavilion: An organization established by the Nine Supreme Beings—the strongest cultivators in the world—to govern forces everywhere.
Currently, while intense war was breaking out everywhere, the time came for the opening of the Holy Realm, the land ruled by the Nine Supreme Beings. The states were forced to cease war for one year.

After inspecting the number of participants, Piao Miao Pavilion revised the list to include rogue cultivators. They saw that there were too many rogue cultivators in the Jianghu, so sending them in to cull their numbers would consolidate Piao Miao Pavilion's power.
Specifically, 10,000 rogue cultivators would participate, including those from the Overseas.

Niu Youdao, the protagonist of the story, was originally a rogue cultivator, but the career he built in Yan State was immense, bringing along many enemies as well as those who wanted to cooperate with him for profit.

After hearing the news that he was unexpectedly put on the Holy Realm list, he went to meet the head of an assassin organization named Xiao Yue Pavilion for help. He was given spies embedded within the forces of the 7 states to use as protective talismans; how to use them was up to him.
(Niu Youdao's key interest relationships to note, as they relate to his upcoming plan):

Wu Zhaohang, Yun Huan, and Yun Ji: 3 teammates trusted by him because Niu Youdao provided them with benefits that only he could offer. For simplicity, regarding the three major sects of Yan State, only the key figures in this arc will be mentioned:
Chu Fengping: This old man plans to cooperate with Niu Youdao to gain benefits from him in Yan State.
Shan Hai: This old man is fairly neutral and also wants to cooperate with Niu Youdao to gain benefits for his sect.

Yan Li: An elder of the Zijin Cave—the sect inviting Niu Youdao to join. However, due to the Holy Realm, this matter is put aside for now. Yan Li has been tasked with protecting Niu Youdao inside the Holy Realm to ensure his safe return.

All 3 Yan State sects want to invite Niu Youdao and are willing to help, but if they cannot protect him, they plan to leave him to fend for himself and find other ways to gain benefits. Thus, cooperation among the 3 sects is very fragile.
Beginning of the Holy Realm: Participants must gather as many "Spirit Seeds" as possible and will receive rewards for ranking first.
Initial Developments:

Upon first entering the gate of the Holy Realm, Niu Youdao was blocked and provoked by the 3 sects of Zhao State due to a prior grudge. He understood that if he didn't deal with this matter right now, he might be bullied while inside the Holy Realm. Immediately, he drew his sword and wiped out 80% of the Zhao State people. Because the commotion was too great, it alarmed Piao Miao Pavilion. After a bout of arguing and reasoning, Niu Youdao was given the punishment of having to take 1st place this time, or else he would be executed.
Main Developments:

Right from the very first day entering the Holy Realm, when the search for Spirit Seeds had not even officially begun, Niu Youdao secretly approached the area of Piao Miao Pavilion's disciples. Taking advantage of a moment when no one was paying attention while they were bathing, he stole a set of uniforms, then released a wild boar to serve as a distraction and the "culprit." This was the preparation step for a long-term plan later on.

The following day, because Chu Fengping failed to recruit Niu Youdao to join him, he turned hostile and used his influence to pressure the other two sects into not offering him support. Both Yan Li and Shan Hai wanted to mediate, but they couldn't, as confronting Chu Fengping at that time risked triggering a civil war. Facing this situation, Niu Youdao took the initiative to separate from the three sects, deciding to find his own path to survival. Knowing it would be very difficult to compete for 1st place, he had already prepared an alternative plan, in which stealing the uniform was a key link in the scheme.
First, he wanted to target the Overseas cultivators, but before going to seek out this crowd, he needed to lay the groundwork for a successful persuasion.

The next day, together with his 3 teammates—Wu Zhaohang, Yun Huan, and Yun Ji—he went looking for disciples of various sects everywhere and encountered 3 disciples from a sect of another state, the Tianhang Sect. He approached them, sent a probing signal, and confirmed that Xu Fuhua was his spy. He then ordered him to eliminate the other 2 members and report back that they were attacked by the Overseas forces.

Furthermore, spreading this news meant Tianhang Sect would search for the Overseas forces on his behalf so he wouldn't need to look for them himself, and they would report back if the Four Seas group was spotted.
10 days later, he met up with that spy again according to the signal and told him to end the operation to avoid detection.
=> planning, strategy.

Next, just like before, Niu Youdao continued to search for his spies across other states and arrived at a group of disciples from Wei State. Niu Youdao proactively went up to ask about their leading elder, Yu Xianding. The disciples of Wei State were extremely on guard. Everyone knew Niu Youdao was being targeted by Piao Miao Pavilion; if pushed to a corner, robbing resources and killing people could very well happen.

However, Niu Youdao reassured them that he wasn't stupid enough to mess with a team backed by an elder. Seeing this, the disciples pointed out the direction. Niu Youdao immediately led his group away. His real purpose was to use the Wei State force to find more of his spies.

According to his reasoning, inside the Holy Realm, all forces chose to scatter and search for Spirit Seeds. Since the range was too vast, gathering everyone in one place was impossible; running back and forth would be an extreme waste of time.
Therefore, the elders of each state usually only specified an approximate direction for the next rally point, and after meeting up, they would disperse once again.
The Wei State disciples didn't know exactly where Yu Xianding was, but the place they pointed to was definitely the next gathering location for the Wei State force.

By evening, Niu Youdao indeed met the three elders of Wei State. He said he only wanted to stay overnight for fear of being assassinated on the road. The three elders saw nothing suspicious about this, so they agreed. That night, under the pretext of gathering firewood, he secretly made contact with the spy Xia Xinruo.

At noon the next day, following the secret signs left behind, he sought them out, killed four Wei State disciples, and had Xia Xinruo return to report that the entire team was ambushed by Overseas cultivators.

Not long after, while leaving together with Xia Xinruo, Niu Youdao encountered a group of Zhao State cultivators. This time, he put on the Piao Miao Pavilion uniform he had stolen earlier, posing as someone from Piao Miao Pavilion to deceive the Zhao State cultivators. He demanded that they bring Chen Ziphei to meet him. After Chen Ziphei appeared, everything proceeded as before. A total wipeout.
However, this time Niu Youdao did not tell Chen Ziphei to frame the Overseas group. He asked about the current situation of the three Zhao State sects.

Chen Ziphei replied that after losing their elder at the Holy Realm entrance, although the three Zhao State sects still cooperated to handle common affairs, they no longer had anyone with enough prestige to make major decisions.

They had considered joining other forces, but feared being taken advantage of. Upon hearing this, Niu Youdao immediately changed his mind. He began to secretly track the Zhao State cultivators' movements through the code marks left by Chen Ziphei. Sometime later, he finally traced the whereabouts of the Overseas cultivators. But Niu Youdao was in no rush to show himself. He knew it was not yet time.
Three months later, Niu Youdao's group of four had quietly searched through almost all the forces once.

This time, the target was his spy Li Yude, a disciple of the Qi Yun Sect from Jin State. At first, everything went just like the previous times: eliminate everyone traveling with him, then shift the blame onto the Overseas crowd. However, variables began to emerge.

According to Li Yude, the Jin State faction was extremely overbearing; after their disciples were killed, they would definitely return to investigate to the very end. Even he began to fear getting exposed. Not long after, Niu Youdao realized he had lost track of one side of his spy lines.
The chain plan, which had been going smoothly, was suddenly cut short. Going back to find Li Yude was impossible, and using the old method to contact other spies wouldn't work either.

Every single time, the rogue cultivator survived unharmed while everyone else was completely wiped out. It was far too contrary to common sense. Continuing like this would easily make others realize someone was deliberately orchestrating a scheme behind the scenes.

A few days later, Niu Youdao began using smoke signals to intentionally draw people closer, but failed repeatedly. Until one day, while observing from atop a tree, he spotted a group of Overseas cultivators being hunted by the disciples of the seven states to the point of running like stray dogs. With just one look, Niu Youdao knew his frame-up plan had succeeded. He immediately took the initiative to meet their leader.

That person was named Hong Gaitian, one of the four major leaders of the Overseas forces this time. Niu Youdao directly proposed a cooperation. He said he could help the Overseas crowd escape their current predicament. Hong Gaitian asked why the seven states had suddenly targeted the Overseas forces.

Niu Youdao merely smiled and analyzed: because this time, the opening of the Holy Realm happened at the wrong moment. The war among the seven states was forcibly halted by Piao Miao Pavilion. Afterward, Piao Miao Pavilion even modified the rules, dragging a large number of rogue cultivators into the Holy Realm. According to Piao Miao Pavilion's intent, a good portion of these rogue cultivators had to die off.

However, upon entering, most of the rogue cultivators were recruited by the seven states to gain an advantage in competing for the 1st place reward. If too many rogue cultivators died, the strength of the states would suffer losses. Therefore, they needed a scapegoat.

The Overseas cultivators were the best choice. As long as enough Overseas people were killed, the rogue cultivators under the seven states wouldn't need to die anymore. If this task wasn't fulfilled, upon exiting the Holy Realm, Piao Miao Pavilion wouldn't make things easy for the seven states.

Now that the seven states had secretly allied to hunt down the Overseas forces, if they didn't cooperate, the Overseas crowd would sooner or later be driven to their deaths in the Holy Realm. Hong Gaitian was half-believing and half-doubting, but didn't drive him away; he only said to wait until tomorrow to gather with the other 3 Overseas factions to verify whether it was true or not.
→ Now Niu Youdao's plan had its foundation established.

→ On one side were the seven states. On the other were the Overseas cultivators. He ordered his spies within the sects to kill their traveling companions, then pinned all the blame on the Overseas crowd, causing news of "Overseas cultivators ambushing and killing people" to continuously spread.

→ Initially, it was just a few small groups hunting them down. But as time went on, the scale grew larger. Gradually, all the forces of the seven states began viewing the Overseas crowd as a target that needed to be purged. Only when the Overseas forces were truly backed into a corner did Niu Youdao make his appearance.
=> deception, planning, mind reading, negotiation, info control.
The next day, Hong Gaitian led Niu Youdao's group to meet the remaining three Overseas factions. The four
Overseas forces this time consisted of:
West Sea Fu Hua
North Sea Wu Chang
South Sea Hong Gaitian
East Sea Lang Jingkong

After a round of persuasion—arguing that even if the Overseas crowd managed to survive the hunt and leave on their own, they would still be pursued everywhere by the seven states, whereas Niu Youdao possessed enough power outside to calm the states, making cooperation with him their best choice.
Furthermore, if they helped him secure 1st place, the rewards would go to them; he only needed to escape execution.

Fu Hua asked what would happen if, after helping him take 1st place, he turned his back on them once they got outside. Niu Youdao answered very swiftly: after the Holy Realm concluded, the states would still have to resume their wars, so there was no need to invite extra trouble over the Four Seas. If they still didn't trust him, they could add some binding ties. Saying so, he directly proposed becoming sworn brothers with the four Overseas leaders.
Niu Youdao knew this sworn brotherhood was purely superficial, but he still needed it to maintain the alliance.

First, Niu Youdao's objective was to target other states to rob Spirit Seeds. Meanwhile, Jin State was currently the strongest faction; after suffering losses, they would certainly spawn the intention to rob the remaining states. Niu Youdao wanted to exploit this point.

Using Jin State as a fuse to provoke hostilities with the six other states would cause both sides to wear each other down. To achieve that, he had to start with the weaker states first, such as Zhao State.

Niu Youdao understood his current situation very well: if he showed his face alone in front of the people from the seven states, he would almost certainly be hunted to death. But the crucial point was that currently, no one knew he had joined forces with the Overseas faction. Thus, the moment they saw Niu Youdao, everyone's immediate reaction would definitely be to hunt him down, never suspecting that an ambush was waiting behind him.

At this time, Fu Hua secretly mentioned to the other three that Niu Youdao, after all, was a Yan State native and couldn't possibly not care about his foundation outside; what if he was a double agent? Hearing this, the three also began to harbor suspicions toward Niu Youdao.

After some time, Hong Gaitian reported having spotted the whereabouts of people from the seven states. Upon inspecting closely, Niu Youdao immediately recognized them as Yan State people. He instantly understood that this group of "superficial sworn brothers" was deliberately testing him.

Niu Youdao knew full well that if this state of suspicion continued, his subsequent plan would surely fail. Therefore, he directly stated that he would give them an answer. Afterwards, he left his three teammates behind as hostages and went alone to find the group of Zijin Cave disciples led by Yan Li.

Upon meeting, Niu Youdao merely told the disciples coldly to go back and inform Elder Yan that someone wished to see him, adding that small fries like them had no right to know what it was about, and that it was best not to let the other two sects find out.

Half a day later, Yan Li arrived alone at the mountaintop to meet him. Only after confirming that no one was following around did Niu Youdao reveal himself. Upon meeting, Yan Li also let out a sigh of relief. After all, he had long been helpless; he wanted to help Niu Youdao but was restrained by the other two sects, and in the end, could only turn a blind eye.

Niu Youdao told Yan Li directly that his goal was to take 1st place in the Holy Realm, so he needed secret support from Zijin Cave. The plan was very simple: he had pulled a group of people to work behind the scenes; the slaughtering and plundering could be left to them to handle, while Yan Li's side only needed to quietly step aside and reveal the locations of the other two sects. In addition, if his total number of Spirit Seeds fell short of competing for 1st place at the end, the Yan State side would have to help make up the difference.

Hearing this, Yan Li frowned, because if their side ranked too low, it would be very difficult to explain to the disciples below. But Niu Youdao calmly replied that it was merely an absolute worst-case scenario.

Returning that evening, Niu Youdao told the four Overseas leaders that he had gone to find an insider. Whether they believed it or not was their business; he didn't bother explaining further. Afterwards, he immediately told them to arrange someone specifically tasked with receiving messages, while Yan Li's side would quietly leave markers and positions of the other factions.

After determining the whereabouts of Chu Fengping's disciples, Niu Youdao used a large quantity of Spirit Seeds as bait, intentionally heading to an easily noticeable spot to light a fire and grill fish. He even deliberately placed a huge bag of Spirit Seeds right beside him, with the mouth of the bag half open.

Unsurprisingly, a nearby group of disciples noticed the column of smoke and quietly crept over. Upon seeing the bag of Spirit Seeds, greed instantly flared up within the entire group. They quickly split up: one person returned to report the news, while several others continued to stalk Niu Youdao.

As for Chu Fengping, after hearing the news that Niu Youdao was still alive, he was also extremely surprised. But upon learning that the opponent was carrying a massive amount of Spirit Seeds, greed immediately surged. He then consulted with another small sect master, Si Tu Yao, wanting to quietly swallow all these Spirit Seeds whole without letting the other two sects find out.
Si Tu Yao actually did not want to oppose Niu Youdao, but he also understood that if he didn't listen to Chu Fengping, their entire group would be in trouble.

Guided by the reporting disciple, a large group quickly gave chase to a mountain cave. At this moment, Niu Youdao deliberately poked his head out to observe, then immediately ducked back inside as if trying to flee. A moment later, he stepped out to face the group.

At that instant, the Overseas group immediately charged out from the shadows in an ambush. Chu Fengping's disciples had no time to react at all and were slaughtered on the spot, with only Si Tu Yao being ordered by Niu Youdao to be spared.

Niu Youdao spared Si Tu Yao because he wanted to turn him into an ally. Moreover, their group had now witnessed Chu Fengping's disciples being killed with their own eyes while standing by without saving them, so even if they returned, they would no longer have any way to explain themselves.

Following the first victory, Niu Youdao continued to use the same tactic to lure other sects. However, during the operation, he unexpectedly discovered Yan Baoru secretly tailing them. Realizing his movements had been exposed, he immediately wanted to strike to silence her. After heavily injuring and interrogating her, he learned that Yan Baoru was sent by Tong Mai, the chief eunuch beside the Yan State Emperor, to assassinate him.

Even so, Niu Youdao did not kill her, choosing instead to subdue and release her. He understood that Yan Baoru would not feel grateful for having her life spared, and might even seek ways to take revenge. But that was precisely what he wanted; he kept her alive as a pawn for a grander layout later on.

Upon returning, Niu Youdao handed all the Spirit Seeds back to the Overseas faction, stating that he had only suffered minor injuries and would take a day off to rest. The next morning, he continued executing the plan, and the next target was one of the three major sects of Han State.

The result was just like before: blinded by the Spirit Seeds, that faction chose to conceal the news without informing the other two sects, wanting to swallow all the profits for themselves. In the end, the entire group fell into an ambush and was completely wiped out, with Niu Youdao's side seizing a large quantity of Spirit Seeds.

After that battle, the four Overseas leaders immediately grew greedy, wanting to ride the momentum to rob the remaining two major sects of Han State. But Niu Youdao directly rejected it. He said that their side had also suffered considerable losses this time, and continuously targeting a single state was unnecessary. The most important thing was not to wipe out any single faction, but to cause the forces to begin suspecting and guarding against one another.

According to the reasoning of the states, if one major sect was wiped out while the other two knew nothing about it, they had very likely been backstabbed by another faction. As long as the seed of suspicion was planted, the states would automatically guard against each other.

He continued analyzing: as long as the forces of each state gradually weakened, they would sooner or later clash with Jin State. And the Jin State people were notoriously arrogant; seeing weakness, they would definitely rush in to plunder. This was precisely what he wanted to see—letting Jin State consume the other states, while the other states conversely consumed Jin State.
As long as the seven states could not fully unite, his plan would continue to function. This was also the reason why Niu Youdao had barely touched Jin State directly from the very beginning.
=> Thinking, Planning, strategy, tactics, adaptability.
Afterward, he continued using the same method to lure the enemy into the trap, but began adapting flexibly according to each state.

For instance, the Zhao State faction—having been ambushed multiple times—became extremely timid. The moment they spotted Niu Youdao's whereabouts, they immediately called the other three sects to join the pursuit. Seeing the situation going unfavorably, he instantly abandoned the plan and retreated immediately.

Next, he shifted his target to the remaining individual major sects of Song State, Qi State, and Wei State, continuing to use Spirit Seeds as bait to lure the opponents' greed, then coordinating with the Overseas forces to launch ambushes.

As for the possibility of being discovered by all seven states one day as the mastermind behind everything, Niu Youdao didn't care at all. According to him, the various factions had already harbored far too deep a mutual suspicion; truly cooperating had become nearly impossible. Furthermore, outside the Holy Realm, he had his own separate arrangements, so he wasn't overly concerned about future consequences.

By this point, he realized he could not continue hunting small groups forever. The Overseas forces were down to around one thousand men; if they continued to be depleted, they would no longer have enough strength to contend with the major sects outside after leaving the Holy Realm.

Moreover, the Overseas crowd only obeyed him because of continuous victories; if their losses were too heavy, this alliance would quickly collapse. Therefore, Niu Youdao decided to change tactics: instead of using Spirit Seeds as bait, he would use himself as the bait for war. As long as news of his appearance was leaked, the various factions would naturally flock over to compete, clash, and slaughter each other. By letting them wear each other down early on, his side would gain many more options to adapt later.

To execute the plan, he secretly handed Si Tu Yao a list of spies within the seven states, instructing him to use Yan State people to contact them and then immediately pull back, without making further appearances.
This was precisely the reason why he had spared Si Tu Yao's life from the very beginning: a pawn reserved for this exact stage.
=> Planning.

However, Niu Youdao did not intend to reveal this strategy to the four Overseas leaders. He understood very well that those "superficial sworn brothers" were currently standing on his side purely out of self-interest; if they knew he intended to drag all seven states into a chaotic free-for-all, they might not let him retain the initiative.

In addition, there was another matter that baffled the four Overseas leaders: from the beginning until now, Niu Youdao had barely touched Wan Shu Sect, Ling Sect, and Tianhang Sect. These three sects maintained a nearly neutral stance, not fully taking any side.

In truth, Niu Youdao intentionally spared them for a deeper layout further down the line, because forces that had not been dragged into the vortex of chaos would still hold immense value for the next chain of stratagems.

But the four Overseas leaders did not know this; on the contrary, they began to suspect why Niu Youdao kept refraining from moving against these three sects. He merely replied nonchalantly that those three sects were not easy targets to swallow, so there was no need to waste military force uselessly.

To reassure his four "superficial sworn brothers," Niu Youdao took the initiative to propose that the next target would be Yan State, adding that Yan Li's side would coordinate the action. Once the plan was settled, the entire group began reorganizing their formation and rested to await the next step.

Back on the Yan State side, Yan Li very quickly received a secret letter from Niu Youdao. In the letter, he requested Yan Li to quietly arrange for Si Tu Yao's group of disciples to depart from the Yan State ranks as naturally as possible.
Following Niu Youdao's instructions, when that group left, they intentionally left behind word that Sect Master Si Tu Yao had gone missing, and they were going out to search for him.

As soon as the news spread, the other forces immediately felt something was off. Recently, the number of missing people had been steadily increasing, and the common denominator was that they all vanished after acting independently or deliberately concealing some information.
Everyone quickly realized that inside the Holy Realm, there was very likely a secret force quietly committing deadly acts in the shadows.
From then on, the sects became far more guarded, no longer daring to scatter their teams to search for Spirit Seeds over a wide area, choosing instead to cluster together for mutual self-defense.

This was what he needed. Once the forces no longer dared to scatter and search, the speed of gathering Spirit Seeds would drop sharply. The longer it dragged on, the more deficient each faction's Spirit Seeds became, until eventually, the only way left was to rob others.

By now, all seven states had begun suspecting one another, especially Jin State. Originally notorious for being aggressive and overbearing, their current presence made the other states even more wary.

Not long after, Li Wohua took the initiative to approach the Wei State side under the pretext of searching for the whereabouts of Sect Master Si Tu Yao. Upon hearing this, the Wei State people immediately asked back whether many people had also gone missing on the Yan State side.
Li Wohua feigned ignorance, replying that he himself was unsure, but currently even Yan Li and Shan Hai were interrogating Chu Fengping, as it seemed he knew something.

Hearing this, the Wei State group immediately marched off to question Chu Fengping. As for Chu Fengping himself, he was actually completely in the dark at this moment; while utterly bewildered, he was already surrounded and questioned by a crowd.
Right as both sides were at a standoff, Yan Li secretly signaled a disciple to step forward and report that in another location, Niu Youdao had just been spotted together with the Overseas group.
Upon hearing Niu Youdao's name, Chu Fengping instantly understood everything. He knew he had been framed and pinned with the blame by Niu Youdao.

The rest of the crowd quickly reacted as well. Those who went missing earlier were very likely coveting Spirit Seeds and thus intentionally hid the news, wanting to swallow them privately, only to be completely wiped out by Niu Youdao in the end.
After stringing everything together, everyone realized that the quantity of Spirit Seeds currently in Niu Youdao's hands was bound to be extremely colossal.

Because of this, the forces of Qi State, Wei State, and Yan State immediately decided to temporarily form an alliance to launch a counter-attack pursuit against Niu Youdao. When asked about the target's whereabouts, the disciple arranged in advance replied immediately that Niu Youdao was fleeing toward the northeast.
The moment the entire group led their teams in pursuit was the exact moment they officially stepped into the trap Niu Youdao had prepared in advance.

This was the most complete stage in Niu Youdao's entire scheme. He created an environment where greed, suspicion, fear of losing resources, and the desire to monopolize benefits naturally drove the factions to act according to his wishes. From using Spirit Seeds as bait, ambushing small groups, sowing doubt among the states, keeping Jin State as a constant pressure, causing factions to cluster together out of fear to search for Spirit Seeds, to turning himself into bait to ignite a chaotic war—every step was tightly linked. As a result, the seven states consumed one another, the speed of gathering Spirit Seeds dropped drastically, no faction retained enough trust to form a genuine alliance, while Niu Youdao held both the advantage in Spirit Seeds and preserved the Overseas forces to prepare for an even deeper layout ahead.

As for Jin State, upon hearing the news that Niu Youdao was likely holding a massive amount of Spirit Seeds, Tai Shu Shanyue immediately grew greedy. To Jin State at this moment, the most important thing was no longer grudges, but the Spirit Seeds. As long as they seized these Spirit Seeds, Jin State would almost directly claim an absolute advantage in the Holy Realm.

On their way tracking Niu Youdao's whereabouts, the Jin State crowd "coincidentally" encountered Li Wohua. But this was naturally no coincidence, as Li Wohua was deliberately sent by Niu Youdao to drag Zhao State into the fold as well. Currently, Zhao State had been frightened out of their wits following the series of prior ambushes. Therefore, when encountering Jin State, the Zhao State people barely dared to resist and were directly forced to merge teams with the Jin State side.

Standing from afar and seeing everything unfold according to plan, Li Wohua quietly departed. In truth, right from the moment he instructed Si Tu Yao's people to withdraw from the Yan State team under the guise of searching for their missing sect master, Niu Youdao had already set into motion the next step of his serial stratagem.

On the way, these people would intentionally "coincidentally" run into other forces, then use Niu Youdao's secret communication channels to link up with the embedded spies within the seven states to continue passing along messages and subsequent plans. This was why a series of seemingly coincidental events occurred.

Han State and Song State learned about the movements of Yan, Wei, and Qi, knowing these three states wanted to rob Niu Youdao's Spirit Seeds. Jin State happened to receive news that the Overseas forces held many Spirit Seeds and grew greedy.

Zhao State was lured by Niu Youdao's title of "slayer of Zhao State disciples" and rushed over to find him, accidentally joining teams with Jin State, only to be forced by Jin State into merging together.

All of this was the result of an intelligence network led and directed by him. Even Yan Li had become a link in the plan. While every force believed they were proactively taking control of the situation, in reality, everyone had been pulled into the exact same trajectory outlined in advance by Niu Youdao.

After a period of rest, the Overseas forces began executing the plan to ambush Yan State in accordance with the agreement with Niu Youdao. Before taking action, he secretly had Si Tu Yao and his people withdraw in order to conceal their identity as insiders. At the same time, the Overseas reconnaissance squads were only tasked with leaving behind signal markers without knowing the actual rally point of the main army, so when danger appeared, they were unable to warn them in time.

As a result, as soon as the main Overseas army struck, they discovered the allied forces of Yan, Qi, and Wei waiting ahead. At the same time, Jin State and Zhao State, followed by Han State and Song State, also entered the fight one after another, forming a two-sided encirclement. The Overseas forces were utterly routed.

This was Niu Youdao's true strategic objective. From beginning to end, the Overseas forces were merely a pawn. He intentionally hid the fact that he had joined forces with Yan Li, only stating that "someone on the Yan State side will coordinate," thus leading the entire Overseas faction straight into the trap he himself had set, turning this battle into the transition toward the final phase of the plan.

→ Sacrificing the Overseas forces was the result of a very early calculation. Niu Youdao understood that this alliance existed purely out of self-interest. Once the Spirit Seeds were divided into smaller portions, internal conflicts would inevitably arise, and the major sects of the seven states would relentlessly pursue them. Even if he could keep the Overseas forces intact, it would be difficult to continue controlling them later on.

→ Therefore, rather than letting the alliance collapse out of control, he proactively turned the entire Overseas faction into a sacrifice in exchange for driving the righteous sects into a massive chaotic battle to wear down each other's strength. Only after the situation had descended into complete chaos could he step into the final phase with more options and greater initiative.

This grand battle served as the crucial turning point for the plan to enter its final phase. Amidst the chaos of the battlefield, two pillars of fire suddenly appeared on the mountain—one large and one small.

Xia Xinruo, Niu Youdao's spy, immediately ran toward the smaller pillar of fire upon seeing the signal. Not just him, but other spies from Xiao Yue Pavilion embedded within the various forces also quietly began to act.

After making a round, Xia Xinruo ran back toward Wei State to report that the Overseas crowd was merely bait. The real purpose was for Niu Youdao to escape with all the Spirit Seeds. Hearing this, Yan Li immediately cooperated in putting on an act. He said that currently the Overseas forces were entangled with other forces; rushing in to compete at this moment could easily drag everyone into an even larger brawl. But letting Niu Youdao escape with the Spirit Seeds would be the absolute greatest loss.

The entire focus of the battlefield was instantly shifted. The allied forces of Yan, Wei, and Qi directly changed their target to pursue Niu Youdao. Not long after, the crowd indeed spotted his whereabouts. At this moment, Niu Youdao was carrying various large and small bags, flying frantically as if fleeing with all the Spirit Seeds. In an instant, everyone's eyes turned red with greed.
